stem.text: A progressive longitudinal sound wave moves through air. The diagram shows the positions of the air particles along part of the wave at one instant.

stem.alt: Row of dots representing air particles, with points P and Q marked above two of them. A double-headed arrow below P and Q is labelled x.

stem.text: Point Q is a distance $x$ from point P.
Which graph shows the variation of the displacement of the air particles with distance from P along the wave?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled displacement and horizontal axis labelled distance, with x marked on the distance axis. A single arch curve starts at the origin and returns to zero at x.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled displacement and horizontal axis labelled distance, with x marked on the distance axis. A single trough curve starts at the origin and returns to zero at x.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled displacement and horizontal axis labelled distance, with x marked on the distance axis. A curve starts at the origin, rises to a peak, falls through zero to a trough and rises again towards x.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled displacement and horizontal axis labelled distance, with x marked on the distance axis. A curve starts above zero at the vertical axis, crosses zero, reaches a trough and rises to a point above zero just before x.
